mapper.select:
select
(IFNULL(day_plan_qty, 0) + IFNULL(night_plan_qty, 0)) as daily_total_qty, b.MONTH_PLAN_QTY as monthPlan, b.MONTH_REMAIN_QTY as monthPlanOs, c.NIGHT_FINISH_QTY as NIGHT_FINISH_QTY, c.DAY_FINISH_QTY as DAY_FINISH_QTY, d.COLOR_TYPE, d.COLOR_CODE, ois.original_line_name
from t_xwyy_schedule_result a
LEFT JOIN ( select MATERIAL_CODE,MONTH_PLAN_QTY,MONTH_REMAIN_QTY,YEAR,MONTH from T_XWYY_MONTH_PLAN_SURPLUS where del_flag = '0' ) b on a.BIG_ROLL_CODE = b.MATERIAL_CODE and b.YEAR = DATE_FORMAT(a.schedule_date,'%Y') and b.MONTH = DATE_FORMAT(a.schedule_date,'%m')
LEFT JOIN T_XWYY_DAY_FINISH_QTY c ON a.BIG_ROLL_CODE = c.BIG_ROLL_CODE AND a.SCHEDULE_DATE = c.SCHEDULE_DATE AND c.DEL_FLAG = '0'
LEFT JOIN T_XWYY_BIG_ROLL_COLOR d ON a.BIG_ROLL_CODE = d.BIG_ROLL_CODE AND d.del_Flag = '0'
LEFT JOIN t_xwyy_original_line_spec ois ON a.ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE = ois.ORIGINAL_LINE_CODE AND ois.del_flag = 0
where a.id = #{id}
